title: Public Events
html:
This page is dedicated to VoIP events where you can see presentations about Kamailio® (OpenSER) or you can meet project representatives (contact via email at sr-dev@lists.sip-router.org).

Note: not all events are listed here, next link is the repository storing many of the presentations related to Kamailio at world wide events:

SIP/SIMPLE – XMPP Developer Workshop, INRIA, Paris, France

September 2-5, 2008

  • http://www-c.inria.fr/Internet/events/appointments/sip-simple-xmpp-developer-workshop/view

The workshop aims to bring together people with large expertise in both protocols, interested in development, testing and deployment of IP/SIMPLE-XMPP solutions. With a permanent focus on innovation, the participants cover open source projects to private enterprises.
